_about: Cards for the owner's notes, calendar and VOOL reminders. Owner-local turns only (core.tool_card_router).

operator.find_notes.use_when: The person wants to find something in the notes they saved.
examples: find my note about the flat viewing
do I have any notes on the garden
what did I write down about the dentist
search my notes for the wifi password
have I got a note with the gift ideas
busca en mis notas lo del piso
cherche dans mes notes la liste de courses
such in meinen Notizen nach dem Rezept
ar turiu užrašą apie butą
not_for: how do I take better notes
what is the best note taking app
write a note to my landlord

operator.show_note.use_when: The person wants to see one saved note by its title.
examples: show me my note called shopping list
open the note titled packing
read me my holiday note
muéstrame la nota de la compra
affiche ma note voyage
not_for: what does a musical note look like

operator.save_note.use_when: The person wants something kept as a note so they can find it later.
examples: make a note that the plumber comes on friday
jot down the wifi password is sunflower42
save a note: call grandma about the pancakes recipe
add to my notes that the car needs an oil change
note this down for me
apunta que tengo que llamar al banco
prends note que la réunion est déplacée
notier dir, dass ich Milch kaufen muss
užsirašyk, kad rytoj skambinti gydytojui
not_for: how do I make a note in the notes app
write a thank you note for my teacher
notes on the history of rome

operator.apple_note_list.use_when: The person wants a list of the notes in their Apple Notes app or one of its folders.
examples: what notes do I have in apple notes
list my notes in the recipes folder
show the notes in my notes app
qué notas tengo en la app de notas
not_for: how do I sync apple notes to icloud

operator.apple_note_read.use_when: The person wants to read one particular note from their Apple Notes app.
examples: read my apple note called packing list
what does my groceries note in apple notes say
open the passwords note in my notes app
not_for: can apple notes be locked with a password

operator.show_agenda.use_when: The person wants to know what is on their calendar for a day, week or other time window.
examples: what's on my calendar tomorrow
do I have anything this weekend
what meetings have I got today
show my schedule for next week
what am I doing on friday
qué tengo en el calendario mañana
qu'est-ce que j'ai à l'agenda cette semaine
was steht morgen in meinem Kalender
ką turiu kalendoriuje šiandien
not_for: how do I share my google calendar
what day of the week is christmas

operator.check_availability.use_when: The person wants to know whether they are free at a certain time or when they have a free slot.
examples: am I free on thursday afternoon
is tuesday at 3 clear
when do I have an hour free tomorrow
can I fit a call in on monday morning
¿estoy libre el viernes por la tarde?
est-ce que je suis libre jeudi
not_for: is the museum free on sundays
what's a good time to have a meeting

operator.search_calendar_event.use_when: The person is looking for a particular event on their calendar by what it is called or about.
examples: when is my dentist appointment
find the accountant meeting on my calendar
when's mia's birthday party in my calendar
cuándo es mi cita con el médico
not_for: when is the next full moon

operator.propose_calendar_event.use_when: The person wants a new event put on their calendar.
examples: put lunch with sam on my calendar friday at 1
add a dentist appointment next tuesday 10am
book a call with the accountant on the 3rd at 11
schedule a meeting tomorrow at 9
pencil in the school play on thursday evening
pon una cita el lunes a las 5
ajoute un rendez-vous jeudi à 14h
trag einen Termin am Montag um 10 ein
not_for: how do I add an event in google calendar
what's a good schedule for studying

operator.list_reminders.use_when: The person wants to see the reminders VOOL is holding for them.
examples: what reminders do I have
show my reminders
did I set a reminder for the bins
list everything you're going to remind me about
qué recordatorios tengo
quels sont mes rappels
not_for: how do reminders work on iphone

operator.schedule_reminder.use_when: The person wants to be reminded about something at a later time.
examples: remind me to call mum at 6
remind me tomorrow morning to take the bins out
set a reminder for the dentist on friday
don't let me forget to pay rent on the 1st
ping me in 20 minutes to check the oven
recuérdame llamar al banco mañana
rappelle-moi d'acheter du pain ce soir
erinnere mich morgen an den Arzttermin
priminkite man rytoj paskambinti mamai
not_for: this reminds me of my childhood
how do I set a reminder on my phone

operator.cancel_reminder.use_when: The person wants a reminder VOOL is holding cancelled.
examples: cancel the reminder about the bins
never mind the dentist reminder
delete my reminder for tomorrow
cancela el recordatorio del banco
not_for: how do I turn off reminders on my phone
